name: Divinum Officium
author: ofrades
description: The traditional Roman liturgy in the bar: the canonical hour for now, the liturgical colour of the day, and the full text of the Office and the Mass.

barWidget.description: Canonical hour, liturgical colour, and the full text of the Office or the Mass from a Divinum Officium server.

schema.label: Divinum Officium server
schema.description: A Divinum Officium instance to read from. The official site disallows automated access to its CGI, so the public Hungarian mirror is the default. Point this at a local container to go fully offline.

schema.label: Rubrics
schema.description: Which historical edition of the breviary to pray.

schema.label: Text language
schema.description: The left column, and the language used when only one is shown.

schema.label: Second language
schema.description: The right column. Choose None, or the same language as the left column, for a single-column office.

schema.label: Your own API
schema.description: Optional. A private Divinum Officium API (see the project's cloudflare/ stack) to read instead of a public mirror. Answers the same paths, so nothing else changes.

schema.label: API service token id
schema.description: Cloudflare Access service token id, sent as CF-Access-Client-Id. Only needed when Your own API is set.

schema.label: API service token secret
schema.description: Cloudflare Access service token secret, sent as CF-Access-Client-Secret.

schema.label: API hours
schema.description: Which hours to read from Your own API. Empty means every hour. A failed API always falls back to the mirror for that request.

schema.label: Open on
schema.description: Which book the panel opens on: the breviary's hours, or the day's Mass.

schema.label: Mass to show
schema.description: Propers shows the texts that change with the day; Full sets them inside the Ordinary of the Mass.

schema.label: Mass
schema.description: The Mass of the day, or a votive Mass from the missal's list: C9 Requiem, C11 B.V.M., C2 Martyr Pontiff, C4 Confessor Pontiff, C5 Confessor, C6 Virgin Martyr, C8 Dedication, V4 St Joseph, V6 the Passion, Coronatio for the Pope, Propaganda for the spread of the faith.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What the bar says: the hour being prayed, the Mass of the day, or both.

schema.label: Bar title length
schema.description: How many characters of the Mass's name to show in the bar before eliding at a word boundary. The rank ("~ II. classis") is always dropped.

schema.label: Hour start times
schema.description: Eight 24-hour clock times, one per hour from Matins to Compline. They decide which hour the bar shows as current.

schema.label: Verse numbers
schema.description: Hide the small verse numbers a psalm is pointed by. The asterisks that mark the mediant stay.

schema.label: Liturgical colour dot
schema.description: Show the colour of the day beside the hour in the bar.
